title: Subspace indicator formula
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $A$ be a linear subspace of $(\mathbf F_2)^n$, and let $x\in(\mathbf F_2)^n$. The indicator of $A$ at $x$ equals $2^{-\operatorname{codim}(A)}$ times the sum, over all $\gamma$ perpendicular to $A$, of the character $y\mapsto(-1)^{\sum_{i=1}^n\gamma_i y_i}$ evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a linear subspace of $(\mathbf F_2)^n$
